announcement.quote: You are receiving the enclosed Combined Prospectus/Information Statement because you owned interests in the Matthews Emerging Asia Fund (the “Target Fund”), a series of Matthews International Funds d/b/a Matthews Asia Funds (the “Trust”)

deals.notes: Registrant is the Trust (CIK 923184); the target and acquirer are series of it, so the episode fund is neither party itself (role recorded as other). The excerpts show no exchange listing for either fund; the acquirer is named only in the agreement excerpt (cash delivered to custodian for Matthews Asia Small Companies Fund). Neither excerpt states an outcome.

problems: Excerpts do not state whether the funds are listed or how the reorganization ended.
